name: Demiplane

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a flat solid surface you can see

summary: A shadowy door on a wall opens onto an empty 30-foot room on its own plane.
text: Anything left inside stays there when the door vanishes. Later castings can make a new demiplane or reopen one you (or someone whose demiplane you know) made before.
